text_block_list.text:
Days passed after festival with Inari One. 
While walking through Tracen Academy front gate—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Main gate this way... Whoa! 
You're that guy from back then...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tahaha, caught me. 
Well~ reason I came here...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
! ...Really? Huge help! 
Hehe... exact opposite of how we met, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whew~ heard rumors, but huge dorm, 
huge gym, huge cafeteria... and massive training track!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...So this is Tracen Academy. 
Crazy facilities sure, but—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Are they... match running? Looks like final stretch... 
trading blows while timin' their surge...)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... right here...! 
HaaaAAAAa!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa!? Already!? 
Ain't it way too early to make break...!?)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: ...! Not... not yet...!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Kh... Fine, then...! Pushing straight through!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: DaaAAAAAA--!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Haaa, haaa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Good. Focus was fixing your final-stretch output. 
Surging early to force stamina battle—great tactic!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Let's build stamina higher. Pivot personal training there. 
Now, for you—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Great job holding line! Believed in closing kick, 
held pace till end. Keep sharpening that.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Both showed great Trainer appeal. 
Keep building up for Debut Races!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirls
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Debut, meanin'... wait, runnin' like that 
without even debutin' yet!? Knew level was high, but—)

--Pardon. We'd like to use this spot, 
mind stepping aside?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! My bad, movin' now— 
...?

My, my~ touring grounds? 
Apologies, didn't mean to crowd you~

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, fine. Nothin' to apologize for...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Huh? These two... what gives? 
Weird... crazy pressure coming off 'em—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. You know anythin' about those two?
choice_data_list: They're Oguri Cap and Super Creek
They're Oguri Cap and Super Creek

text_block_list.text:
Explained to her: neither debuted yet. 
However—
choice_data_list: Both of them have huge potential

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, haa, haa...!! 
Right here... take lead!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... won't let you!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri&Creek
text_block_list.text: HaaAAAAAAAa!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Oi... oi oi oi, what's with them!? 
White girl had total blank face earlier, 
now running like total demon!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Other one too, huge girl! Bottomless... 
can't see end to her depth! Just watchin' 
feels suffocatin'...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: What the hell... who are these two...!?

Beside me, Inari One held breath, 
visibly rattled by their duel, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list: You can win against those two
You can win against those two

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
--400m to go! Oguri Cap leads, 
but Super Creek surges! Super Creek takes lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, Oguri Cap... and here comes Inari One!! 
Inari One bursts through!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: DaaAAAARyaaAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
200m left! Who takes it, 
Inari One or Super Creek!? Leader is—

text_block_list.name: Inari&Creek
text_block_list.text:
OraaAAAAAAAAAAAAA!! 
HaaAAAAAA---!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! It's Inari One!! Inari One grabs lead!! 
--And across line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Winner of fierce duel, Inari One!! 
Stands erupt into roaring cheers!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(...Grittin' out win against beasts like that. 
Roar louder than fireworks, Chief 
and everyone from town cheerin' on)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Then after win, 
those guys run over screamin' with joy—)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Uwaah!? Ah... j-just now... 
............

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry! Gotta... take off now!!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief. Thought this might happen, knucklehead.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
We meet again, Trainer-san. 
Well then――

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text:
Got favor to ask. 
...Next time, got race want you to see. What say you?
